clue.text: Strike? One of a series

definitions.meaning: striking a match is the way to try it out, so the question playfully describes testing one
an international cricket fixture, one of several played in a series between two countries

explanation.walkthrough: A test match is an international cricket game; Tests are played in a series of several.
explanation.definitionFit: Whimsically, striking is how you test a match; seriously, it is a cricket international played as part of a series.

clue.text: It expires at the end of three months

definitions.meaning: a glowing coal dying away in a fire

definitions.text: at the end of three months
definitions.meaning: September, November and December all finish with these five letters

explanation.definitionFit: A dying coal fading in the grate, and the closing letters shared by September, November and December.

clue.text: Lancing's propelling force

definitions.meaning: a lunge or stab with a lance or spear
the driving push of an engine or rocket

explanation.definitionFit: A lunge with a lance is a forward stab, and an engine's driving push is likewise named by this word.

clue.text: One who composes a golden headed war god

indicators.note: the golden piece goes at the head, in front of the god

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
Thor is the Norse god of thunder and war

explanation.surface: A writer is described as a war god with golden hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer composes books, so a composer of words fits.

clue.text: It may show up on time but is gone in a flash

definitions.text: It may show up on time but is gone in a flash

parts.words: It may show up on time but is gone in a flash
parts.note: a celestial visitor that returns on a predictable schedule yet streaks across the sky and vanishes

explanation.definitionFit: Periodic heavenly bodies such as Halley's return on schedule but blaze briefly across the sky.

clue.text: A third note's missing, query the amount possibly in Planck's method

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters may be rearranged into something else

parts.note: E is the third note of the scale of C major (C, D, E)

explanation.surface: A puzzle about musical notes and a query over quantity in a physicist's method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' says E leaves the pool: QUERY THE AMOUNT has the answer's letters plus an E, and 'possibly' rearranges what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Planck founded the physics of discrete energy packets, so his approach is this theory.

clue.text: Real come-down for the astronaut

parts.note: a space traveller's descent from orbit is literally coming down, while the phrase also means being brought back to reality

explanation.definitionFit: Coming back from space is literal descent, and the idiom means coming back to reality after excitement.

clue.text: Given an official seal of approval

definitions.text: Given an official seal of approval

parts.words: Given an official seal of approval
parts.note: authorised with an inked mark, often routinely and without scrutiny

explanation.definitionFit: Documents approved by bureaucracy get an inked office mark, hence routine official sanction.

clue.text: Charge for being a citizen?

parts.note: charge reads like a fee or tax, but here it is a responsibility laid on every member of a community

explanation.definitionFit: Voting or jury service are obligations of citizenship; a duty can also be a tax, hence the play on charge.

clue.text: Kind of work that provides little standing

definitions.text: Kind of work that provides little standing

parts.words: Kind of work that provides little standing
parts.note: standing looks like status, but it means being on one's feet: desk jobs involve sitting

explanation.definitionFit: Desk-bound jobs are done seated, so they involve little time on one's feet.

clue.text: Outside bullring winner loses his head

indicators.note: the first letter of the word winner is dropped

explanation.surface: A victor at a bullfight, waiting outside the arena, loses his head.
explanation.walkthrough: On an archery or darts target, the ring just outside the bull is called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Target rings are named from the centre out; the one immediately round the bull carries this name.

clue.text: About right about the armistice

indicators.note: the second about means one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: right in the sense of correct, true
c is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A ceasefire is described as being more or less right.
explanation.definitionFit: An armistice is an agreed halt to fighting, a ceasefire.

clue.text: Short time in a Channel Island with nothing on

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the island's name

parts.note: Sark is one of the Channel Islands, between England and France
t is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A brief stay on a Channel Island spent naked.
explanation.definitionFit: Naked, as in the phrase stark naked.

clue.text: Meistersinger with talent; bags of it we hear

indicators.note: says the word is judged by its sound when spoken

parts.note: bags are sacks

explanation.surface: A gifted master singer is said to have lots of talent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bags of it' also suggests lots of talent. Hans Sachs is the cobbler-poet hero of Wagner's opera Die Meistersinger.
explanation.definitionFit: Hans Sachs, the gifted cobbler-poet, is the central master singer in Wagner's opera.

clue.text: Empty Indian city market-place

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Empty Indian city market-place (5)': the parse is O (Empty) inside AGRA, but no word signals the insertion, and 'Empty' cannot be both the O and the indicator; the original wording may have been lost in OCR.

clue.text: It makes a good turnover for the craftsman

definitions.text: It makes a good turnover for the craftsman

parts.words: It makes a good turnover for the craftsman
parts.note: turnover sounds like profit, but the word reads the same either way round, and it is a small boat or craft for one man

explanation.definitionFit: A canoe-like boat is a craft for one paddler, and the word is a palindrome.

clue.text: Lizard upset again going round the bend

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap round the bend
upset says the letters of again are knocked into a new order

parts.note: a U-bend, the letter U shaped like a bend

explanation.surface: An agitated lizard goes round a corner again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns AGAIN into IGANA, which goes round U.
explanation.definitionFit: A large tropical American lizard.

clue.text: By way of being a seat of action

parts.note: a venue is the place where something happens

explanation.surface: A phrase meaning 'by means of being a place where things happen'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' and 'of being' are link words joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A broad street or road, a route.

clue.text: Friend of Old Nick initially into call out

indicators.note: the initials are put inside the shout

parts.note: to call out is to cry

indicators.note: takes the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: A friend of the Devil is told to shout.
explanation.walkthrough: Old Nick is a nickname for the Devil; here only the initials are wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A close companion or pal.

clue.text: Assign the cad to special service

indicators.note: putting the letters to a special use reworks them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An order sending a bounder off on special duties.
explanation.definitionFit: In military usage, to send troops or officers on a separate task.

clue.text: Maximum effort at the end of the innings

definitions.text: at the end of the innings
definitions.meaning: in cricket, when every batsman has been dismissed the side is finished

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an innings ends when ten batsmen are dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: Total exertion, and a cricket team's state when its whole batting side has been dismissed.

clue.text: Trace a coaster

definitions.meaning: a small single-masted sailing boat used along the coast

explanation.definitionFit: A hint or taste of something, and a small fishing or coastal sailing vessel.

clue.text: Fancy one sees it in high dudgeon on the motorway

indicators.note: in a down clue the motorway sits on top of the rest

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in M1
the Roman numeral I is one
high dudgeon is fury, rage

explanation.surface: A driver, furious on the motorway, imagines things.
explanation.definitionFit: An illusion or fanciful image, like shimmering water seen on a hot road.

clue.text: Cuban leader's a star turn in company

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go inside the company abbreviation
turn says the letters of star are rotated into another order

explanation.surface: A Cuban leader's performance is the highlight of a troupe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' rearranges the letters of star; the A before it is taken as it stands, and Co is the usual short form of company.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidel Castro led Cuba for nearly fifty years after its revolution.

clue.text: Border flower material

definitions.meaning: flower means river (a thing that flows)

explanation.definitionFit: The river forming part of the Anglo-Scottish boundary, and a woven woollen cloth.

clue.text: Scenery at the beginning of the month or later

parts.note: Dec is short for December

explanation.surface: Stage scenery arriving at the start of December or later.
explanation.definitionFit: Stage sets and furnishings are the visual decoration of a theatre.

clue.text: One in flight

parts.note: flight suggests a bird or plane, but it is a set of steps, one of which is meant

explanation.definitionFit: A flight of stairs is made up of individual steps.

clue.text: Channel on which the sun is reflected

indicators.note: a mirror image, so the two words are read backwards

explanation.surface: A water channel whose surface mirrors the sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavity or passage in the body, such as in the skull or a fistula.

clue.text: Be off-putting in a manner of speaking

definitions.text: Be off-putting in a manner of speaking

parts.words: Be off-putting in a manner of speaking
parts.note: off-putting looks like being unpleasant, but taken literally it means putting things off till later

explanation.definitionFit: To keep delaying tasks is literally to put them off.

clue.text: Drinks on the landlord at this pub?

definitions.text: Drinks on the landlord at this pub?

parts.words: Drinks on the landlord at this pub?
parts.note: drinks on the house are free, and a pub not tied to one brewery has a name built from that idea

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a pub owned independently, free to sell any brewer's beer, has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: A British pub not tied to a brewery, punningly read as one where drinks cost nothing.
